# `failCauseToConstructor`

Suggests Effect.fail/die/failSync/dieSync instead of failCause/failCauseSync wrapping a single Cause.fail/die

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377155` |
| Language Service name | `failCauseToConstructor` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/fail-cause-to-constructor` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Cause, Effect } from "effect"

export const crashed = Effect.failCause(Cause.die(new Error("boom")))
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(fail-cause-to-constructor): `Effect.die` expresses this failure directly instead of wrapping `Cause.die` in `Effect.failCause`.
*/
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "failCauseToConstructor": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
